steps.label: The Sun
steps.narrationCue: The Sun sits at the origin. Compressed orbit scale keeps every world within a few thousand scene units.

steps.label: Earth, compressed
steps.narrationCue: Earth in the artistic layout — close enough to fly between worlds without a year of travel.

steps.label: Earth, realistic AU
steps.narrationCue: The same epoch with AU-proportional spacing. Inner planets recede; the date scrubber still drives Standish positions.

steps.label: Saturn's rings
steps.narrationCue: Back to compressed scale for Saturn. Ring shadows and the ice giants stay in one navigable orrery.

steps.label: 2017 total solar eclipse
steps.narrationCue: The Great American Eclipse of 21 August 2017. Epoch from a documented landmark; geometry comes back out of the ephemeris.
